summary: Batch 1 implements M1 read-only merge-queue classification, M3 read-only Goal closure/stall projections, and M4-A advisory same-contract-key hints. No new write authority, no strict Lane admission, no auto-approval or deployment. Exact PR base 4f1628ed8110323e88ad5292025f88d337738383.

components.owning_subsystem: Goal coordination read model, merge-queue failure classification, and safe next-command presentation
components.disposition: ADMIT read-only projection extensions on existing Goal/Task/Lane/merge-queue stores; preserve legacy fields, expose actionable/terminal/unknown and source completeness, never claim completion on incomplete evidence
evidence: M1 uses existing merge_queue.jsonl and lanes.jsonl, preserves legacy buckets and adds actionable/terminal/unknown classification; damaged or absent source is marked degraded, safe_to_execute=false.
M3 reuses existing goal_gates.complete_gate and activity timestamps to display closure/stalled candidates without changing Goal status or writing to audit ledgers.

components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Independent reviewer may veto if classification permits unsafe action, closure writes state, or degraded source is hidden. Fail closed: retain read-only legacy output or revert isolated branch, correct the defect, re-freeze, re-review and re-run complete gate before PR merge.
components.rollback_route: Revert the PR merge (or do not merge); no data migration, no auto Goal closure, no live service restart or state writes introduced by these projections.

components.owning_subsystem: LaneStore admission precheck, lane_open presentation, merge queue submission read-only advisory
components.disposition: ADMIT deterministic M4-A same-contract-key hints only. Same key is not semantic conflict, does not block or authorize any operation. Do not introduce M2-A enforce_cross_goal or M4-B claim registry in this PR.
evidence: LaneStore.contract_same_key_hint reads in-flight lanes only, excludes self, matches normalized contract keys and sorts deterministically; no new ledger, lock, approval field, or write authority.
run_lane_open and run_lane_queue_submit attach hints to existing result branches, including duplicate and preflight paths, with no changes to existing queue admission verdicts.

tests/unit/test_lane_contract_hint_batch1.py covers no-match, active vs terminal, self exclusion, deterministic ordering, duplicate/preflight/final result branches and advisory-only behavior; independent GLM-5.3 PASS for exact source c30178a7c.
components.verification_level: Focused M4-A positive/negative tests and existing Lane/merge-queue regressions; original full R9 CLEAN on c30178a7c; no new security enforcement claim; GitHub PR checks must pass on manifest commit SHA.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: If hints change admission, cause new writes, claim user approval, or falsely classify same key as conflict, block merge; revert the isolated change and re-run review/R9 after correction. Hints alone never grant permissions.
components.rollback_route: Revert this PR or disable advisory UI usage; no persistent schema change, no contract-claim store, no service-side deployment required.

components.verification_level: A.5 exact changed-path coverage, schema validation, independent semantic review, no modifications to guard/test baseline; original full R9 on code candidate and new manifest-only SHA before merge.

g1.necessity: Operators and main agents cannot distinguish historical terminal queue failures from current actionable blockers when legacy buckets mix them, and Goal completion candidates are not visible without manual cross-ledger investigation. Read-only projections address the visibility gap without granting action authority.

g2.authority_owner: Existing GoalStore/TaskStore, LaneStore, merge-queue ledger and goal_gates.complete_gate retain authoritative state and final decisions; goal_coordination.py is a derived read model only.
g2.non_duplication: No new state machine, ledger, approval channel, or Goal completion endpoint; legacy keys remain available and all new fields are explicitly non-authoritative.

model_evidence: Reviewer subagent_42c913b1d8ba original PASS P0/P1=0; reviewer subagent_4ce87256c1c9 fresh exact-SHA c30178a7c PASS P0/P1=0, G1-G8 closed.
BUG-11/12/13/14 and BUG-15 negative-test evidence in docs/queues; original R9 c30178a7c CLEAN exit 0; M1 source-corrupt and M3 active-only tests.
g3.recovery_or_reason: If source is absent, malformed, truncated, or unreadable, show unknown/degraded and safe_to_execute=false; never synthesize authorization or mark a Goal complete; rollback via revert.

g4.rollback: Revert PR commit(s) to restore previous projections and legacy view; no migration or durable state changes.

Remote PR CI exact head SHA, A.5 path coverage and privacy gate, then merge/push CI.

g1.necessity: Parallel Lane work can independently declare the same external contract key, and silent overlap makes review coordination harder. A deterministic advisory warning helps human/model review without inventing an incompatibility verdict.

g2.authority_owner: Existing LaneStore and merge-queue stores own admission and queue state; explicit user approvals and existing gates remain the only authority. This change adds read-only hints only.
g2.non_duplication: No M4-B contract_claims registry, no new approval role, no strict cross-Goal write lock or bypass; same key does not imply conflict and never blocks by itself.

model_evidence: Reviewer subagent_4ce87256c1c9 PASS P0/P1=0 on c30178a7c; same-key hint limited to in-flight lanes and deterministic sorted output.
tests/unit/test_lane_contract_hint_batch1.py positive/negative branches, no-approval and no-block behavior; original complete R9 CLEAN on c30178a7c.
g3.recovery_or_reason: If hint generation fails, existing lane/queue operation continues with explicitly advisory or omitted hint; no new write authority. A genuine authorization or side-effect regression is a merge blocker and requires revert/fix.
